say:7:1320335004:1.text: But I'm sure Levski would like to meet the one who restored his masterpiece...
say:7:1320335004:1.source_cn: 但如果列夫斯基主动提出想见你一面，我们总不能一直拦着他吧？

say:8:1320335005:1.text: How about you wait outside Cedartown? That way, we can find you in no time! You know Levski's condition...
say:8:1320335005:1.source_cn: 不如你跟着我们一起过去，在雪松镇外等待？这样我们可以以...

say:9:1320335006:1.text: ...I understand. I'll wait for you outside Cedartown.
say:9:1320335006:1.source_cn: ……我明白了。我会在雪松镇外等你们的。

say:10:1320335007:1.text: I believe you should set off at your earliest convenience.

choice:5:0:1.text: Why don't you deliver it yourself?
